chunks: Tell them: 'The unclean and the pure are not equal, even though the abundance of the unclean may be pleasing to you.' So fear God, O men of wisdom; you may haply find success.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the impure and the pure in terms of quantity and quality according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to distinguish between quantitative majority and qualitative superiority, emphasizing that the 'people of intellect' (ul al-albab) must discern truth from falsehood regardless of the latter's numerical abundance. It underscores the spiritual principle that inner purity (tayyib) outweighs external volume (kathrah), a concept central to understanding the status of the Ahl al-Bayt amidst the broader community. The call to 'fear God' serves as the practical mechanism for maintaining this discernment and achieving ultimate felicity (falah).
